title: (Enhancement) Uploading loop data + bg to Glooko for doctors office
body:
Is there any chance to get a connection between aaps and Glooko? My endo uses Glooko to get my diabetes data and this could be a really nice enhancement for a wide range of people all over the world. I don't know if this is possible because aaps isn't an official way to manage our glucoselevels.

https://glooko.com/

comments.body: They are not giving access to not certified devices

Most of apps don't support import from other apps, usually you have to have opensource application/site/portal to allow that (import). Give your doc your Nightscout url, and he should be able to see the data (if we wants to). I usually just go into NS and print the graphs for last month and this is enough for him. @FreDiabetics
